articles.title: Did a Super-Powerful Space Particle Come from a Black Hole Cannon?
articles.summary: Scientists found the most powerful space particle ever, deep in the ocean. It had the energy of a ping-pong ball moving super fast. Now they think it came from a blazar—a black hole shooting a jet of energy right at Earth.

articles.title: This Ancient Fish's Brain Holds Clues to How Animals First Walked on Land
articles.summary: Scientists used special X-rays to peek inside a 380-million-year-old fish skull from Antarctica. They found its brain was a lot like the first animals that crawled onto land. It even had a built-in 'skylight' on its head to breathe air!

articles.title: Caught on Video: Sperm Whales Team Up to Help a Mom Give Birth
articles.summary: For the first time ever, scientists filmed a sperm whale giving birth. The video shows a whole group of whales helping the mom, even ones not related to her. They took turns lifting the newborn calf to the surface so it could breathe.
